gloss: to join, to graft, to set (bones)

definitions.explanation: To align broken bones for healing.
To join a part of one plant to another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{接|つ}ぐ。
⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{接|つ}いで⟦{直|なお}した→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I repaired the broken board by joining the pieces together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{接|つ}いで、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined many short pieces of cloth together to make a large curtain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{接|つ}いで⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the broken bone set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{接骨院|せっこついん}→接骨院：20981_sekkotsuin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{接|つ}いで⟦もらったら→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.english: Create new varieties by grafting fruit trees.
I am growing cherry blossoms by grafting branches onto another tree.

notes:
{接|つ}ぐ means to join, connect, or set (bones), typically connecting separate pieces.
